subject: Mutual plan kickoff — weekly sync, deliverables & success criteria
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Richardson <ava@peregrine.ai>, Jorge Mendes <jorge.m@peregrine.ai>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Mutual plan kickoff — weekly sync, deliverables & success criteria

Hi Ava / Jorge,

Thanks again for the call yesterday — excited to kick off the evaluation and get to a close plan that maps to Peregrine's timeline. I put together a short mutual plan (attached) and proposal for a lightweight weekly checkpoint cadence so we can move quickly but keep stakeholders aligned.

Proposed kickoff items (high level):
- Cadence: Weekly 30m checkpoints; first meeting proposed Thu Oct 8, 10:00–10:30 PT.
- Goal: Complete 2-week technical evaluation -> production pilot in 6 weeks (see milestones in attached MAP).
- Success criteria (pass -> move to pilot):
  - Latency: median generation latency < 200ms for 256-token prompts on the target instance profile.
  - Throughput: sustained 50 concurrent requests with 95th pct tail < 400ms.
  - Quality: average rubric score >= 4.0 on the 10-sample acceptance set (evaluation_plan_v1.md attached).
  - Cost: per-1k-token cost within the committed threshold in the attached worksheet.
- Evaluation plan: Tessa to run the harness against shared sample data; Marcus to provision a dedicated sandbox with pinned model version + KV cache settings.
- Security checkpoints: quick review of SOC2 excerpt during week 0, followed by evidence handoff to procurement.

Initial actions I want to confirm before the first sync:
1) Peregrine provides sample dataset (anonymized) and a list of critical prompt types (Ava) — due by Oct 6.
2) Redwood to provision API keys and a sandbox cluster (Marcus) — due Oct 7.
3) Evaluation harness and metrics dashboard (Tessa) — initial run by Oct 14.

Attachments: MAP_Peregrine_v1.xlsx (mutual action plan with milestones), evaluation_plan_v1.md, SOC2-excerpt.pdf.

Can you confirm attendees and whether Thu 10:00 PT works, or propose an alternate slot? Once we settle cadence I'll send a calendar invite and create the HubSpot MAP record (linked).

Thanks — looking forward to the kickoff.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
https://www.redwood.ai | (415) 555-0163
From: Ava Richardson <ava@peregrine.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jorge Mendes <jorge.m@peregrine.ai>, procurement@peregrine.ai
Date: 2026-10-04T12:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan kickoff — weekly sync, deliverables & success criteria

Thanks Hannah — this looks great and pragmatic. A couple quick notes: 
- Preferred cadence: Wed 9:30–10:00 PT would work better for our SRE/ML team on our side this quarter. If Thu is easier for Redwood, we can be flexible.
- Attendees to include from Peregrine: Nora Chen (SRE), Luis Ortega (Head of ML), plus myself and Jorge. I'll loop procurement on the SOC2 path — procurement@peregrine.ai is on CC.
- On success criteria: the latency/throughput targets look reasonable, but we need the ability to test with our long-context prompts (up to 2k tokens) during the evaluation window. Please confirm instance profile and whether KV caching will be enabled in the sandbox.

Action items on our side:
- I'll send anonymized sample data and prompt list by Oct 6 (Ava).
- Procurement will follow up separately about contract timeline and a template NDA if needed.

I've attached an internal timeline and a short note on data-handling expectations — procurement will escalate if they need a separate evidence bundle.

On Wed vs Thu — propose Wed 9:30 PT as primary; if Redwood can't accommodate we'll take Thu. Confirm?

Best,
Ava Richardson
Head of Platform, Peregrine Analytics
ava@peregrine.ai | +1 312-555-2410
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, Ava Richardson <ava@peregrine.ai>
Cc: Jorge Mendes <jorge.m@peregrine.ai>
Date: 2026-10-04T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan kickoff — weekly sync, deliverables & success criteria

Thanks — happy to take the provisioning and sandbox work. Quick notes from infra: 
- I'll provision a sandbox cluster with a quantized model variant and KV cache enabled (we'll document exact instance types in the invite). Expect API keys and access by EOD Oct 7.
- Suggestion on cadence: do a 60m technical deep-dive on the first meeting (week 0) to walk the harness and run an initial smoke test, then move to 20–30m weekly checkpoints focused on blockers + metric review. That pattern has worked well for similar customers.

Assigned items:
- Marcus: create MAP_Peregrine_v1.xlsx baseline and push to HubSpot (ETA Oct 5).
- Tessa: prepare the evaluation harness and initial metric dashboard; will run smoke test once sample data is received (ETA Oct 14).

If Wed 9:30 PT is required for Peregrine, I can adjust. Otherwise, I like the idea of reserving an hour for the first session so we can get a clean smoke run.

—Marcus
Marcus Lin
Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah@redwood.ai>
To: Ava Richardson <ava@peregrine.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jorge Mendes <jorge.m@peregrine.ai>, procurement@peregrine.ai
Date: 2026-10-05T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Mutual plan kickoff — weekly sync, deliverables & success criteria

Appreciate the quick replies — good tradeoffs. Final plan below: 

Cadence and meetings:
- Week 0 (deep-dive): Wed Oct 7, 9:30–10:30 PT (60m) — smoke test, provisioning walkthrough, agree on runbook.
- Regular checkpoints: weekly Thu 10:00–10:20 PT (20m) starting Oct 15. If conflicts arise we'll default to Wed 9:30 PT for that week.

Confirmed attendees (initial):
- Peregrine: Ava Richardson, Jorge Mendes, Nora Chen (SRE), Luis Ortega (Head of ML), procurement@peregrine.ai
- Redwood: Hannah Schmitt, Marcus Lin, Tessa Morgan

Action item summary (owner — due):
- Peregrine: provide anonymized sample dataset + prompt list — Ava — due 2026-10-06
- Redwood: provision sandbox + API keys — Marcus — due 2026-10-07
- Redwood: MAP baseline and HubSpot MAP record — Marcus — due 2026-10-05
- Redwood: evaluation harness + initial dashboard — Tessa — first run by 2026-10-14
- Procurement check & SOC2 evidence path — procurement@peregrine.ai — procurement to follow up directly

Next steps: I'll send calendar invites for both the deep-dive (Wed Oct 7 9:30–10:30 PT) and the recurring Thu 10:00–10:20 PT checks; links and meeting notes will be stored in the HubSpot MAP record (link included above).

If anyone has additions to the success criteria or wants to add a secondary owner to any item, reply to this thread and I'll update the MAP.

Thanks all — see you on Wed.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
https://www.redwood.ai
